overview.title: Working leather, not a theme park
overview.p1: Near Bab Targhount, Taroudant still has traditional tanning and leather workshops. The craft is real, on a smaller scale than in larger cities.
overview.p2: Expect strong smells and informal access. A tip is customary if someone shows you around.
overview.p3: Keep visits short, ask before photos of people, and wear sturdy shoes.
